prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity, shippable desktop PROJECT CASE-STUDY page north-star comp, exactly 1536×1024 landscape, straight-on full-bleed website screenshot with no browser chrome, no device frame around the page, and no surrounding mockup scene.

Input images:
Image 1 is the pixel-authoritative reference for Marc Mansour portfolio’s established “Activity Ledger” visual identity only. Preserve its disciplined cobalt skeleton rules, ruled working-paper material, three typography voices, square dossier geometry, sparse lime data ink, and one signal-red proof gesture. Do not copy its homepage composition, homepage content, financial chart, GitHub activity, hero split, or dark homepage arrangement.
Images 2, 3, and 4 are official Savyy iOS promotional screenshots. Use faithful, recognizable clipped portions of these supplied screens as real evidence inside selected ledger rows. Preserve their authentic dark product UI, French interface, deep blue backing, phone edges, and source proportions; do not redraw a generic fintech interface and do not invent alternate app screens.

Primary request:
Design a founder-authored portfolio project case-study page titled exactly “The Founder’s Build Ledger.” A compact Savyy project identity and founder note open at upper left, while an oversized numbered vertical build record owns most of the viewport. The page must read as a thoughtful founder case study documenting product decisions, not as Savyy’s marketing site, a generic fintech dashboard, a poster, or a timeline of little cards.

Scene/backdrop:
Cool recycled day-paper stock, full-bleed, with subtle fiber grain and faint horizontal 32px ruling. Construct the page with thin cobalt-blue rules before adding any filled surface. Use one pale red notebook margin line. Mostly flat and square; any tiny overlap must explain physical clipped evidence resting on paper.

Subject and layout:
A narrow left founder column occupies roughly 28% of the viewport. At its top place a compact mono identifier “SAVYY / PROJECT 01”, then the exact title “The Founder’s Build Ledger.” in a sturdy Bitter-like slab serif at a controlled editorial scale, followed by the exact note “Founder note — Why I built Savyy, and the boundaries that shaped it.” in readable Open Sans-like prose. Place the main square cobalt action “OPEN SAVYY.APP” directly below, with two quieter square outline actions “APP STORE” and “GOOGLE PLAY”. Keep this column compact and editorial, not a standard hero.

The remaining roughly 72% is one continuous vertical build ledger with shared edges and uninterrupted cobalt rules—never separate floating cards. Show four numbered rows in order:
“01 FINANCIAL PROBLEM”
“02 BANK CONNECTIVITY”
“03 PRIVATE CATEGORIZATION”
“04 WEB + NATIVE DELIVERY”

Use very large Source Code Pro-like index numerals, strong Bitter-like row titles, and Open Sans-like factual prose. Create clear scale differences: rows 01 and 02 are compressed register lines, row 03 is the visually dominant current entry and expands into a deep evidence field, and row 04 is a strong closing row. Clip faithful portions of Images 2–4 across selected evidence zones so official Savyy phone screens interrupt and pass behind the cobalt ledger rules. Make the devices feel catalogued as evidence, not advertised as product glamour. At the bottom edge, reveal only the opening cobalt rule and oversized “05” of the next record below the fold, with no invented title or claim.

Required factual labels, verbatim:
“ONE VIEW FOR PERSONAL FINANCES IN FRANCE AND EUROPE”
“4,000+ EUROPEAN BANKS VIA BRIDGE”
“READ-ONLY ACCESS”
“DATA NEVER USED FOR MODEL TRAINING”
“WEB, IOS AND ANDROID”
“SHARED DATA”

Use a single signal-red proof gesture to circle or underline the word “NEVER” within “DATA NEVER USED FOR MODEL TRAINING”. Use sparse lime only as one tiny data/evidence tab or registration mark. Do not use lime as a broad brand fill.

Style/medium:
Production-realistic editorial web UI screenshot; Marc Mansour’s Activity Ledger identity; precise modern information design; sturdy Bitter-like slab serif for title and ledger statements; highly legible Open Sans-like sans serif for notes and facts; Source Code Pro-like mono for indices, labels, actions, and registration marks. Crisp vector-like rule geometry, tactile recycled paper, square edges, mature asymmetric desktop composition.

Composition/framing:
Exactly 1536×1024 landscape. A slim portfolio register header may sit above the page body, but it must remain quiet and must not recreate the homepage navigation composition. The left founder column begins immediately beneath it. The continuous numbered ledger begins near the upper third and dominates horizontal area and visual weight. Every row shares the same outer rails. Keep row 03 unmistakably dominant. Ensure every required phrase is horizontal, sharp, legible, and unobstructed at native size. Show the start of record 05 below the lower fold edge.

Lighting/mood:
Flat archival daylight, cerebral, candid, rigorous, inspectable, founder-led rather than promotional.

Color palette:
Recycled paper #F4F7F5, raised stock #FBFCFA, deep ink #101828, muted ink #435164, cobalt #174EA6, cobalt-dark #103B80, faint cobalt rules, one tiny data-lime #9FD818 mark, one signal-red #C8313B proof gesture. Preserve the official dark navy and violet tones only inside the supplied Savyy screen evidence.

Materials/textures:
Subtle recycled paper fibers, faint 32px horizontal ruling, thin cobalt press lines, clipped square dossier geometry, authentic supplied phone-screen crops, crisp ink. No decorative gloss and no ordinary card shadows.

Text constraints:
Render every specified title, record label, factual label, note, and action exactly as written and only once. Keep the apostrophe in “Founder’s”. Use the official Savyy screens as supplied evidence rather than fabricating app content. Do not add numbers or product claims beyond the supplied factual labels.

Constraints:
This is a project case-study page inside Marc Mansour’s portfolio. Preserve the established identity without copying the homepage structure or content. Use one continuous ledger, not a sequence of small cards. Keep the main CTA unmistakably primary. No invented users, revenue, awards, testimonials, outcomes, performance metrics, balances, dates, prices, growth claims, employer details, social proof, logos other than the text name Savyy, or fabricated app data. No watermarks.

Avoid:
homepage hero split; GitHub contribution calendar; financial model chart; Savyy marketing-page composition; generic fintech dashboard; mood poster; timeline of little cards; equal bento cards; rounded cards; pills; gradients; glassmorphism; neon; crypto aesthetic; glowing edges; glossy 3D; fake device mockup scene; browser chrome; perspective webpage; people; stock photos; invented icons; decorative microcopy; illegible pseudo-text; duplicated labels; misspelled required text; watermarks.
